description: Plan an affiliate program for a product before launching it: a commission rate, whether to pay on renewals, and how to approve affiliates, from LinkJolt's published benchmarks of real SaaS programs, plus what an affiliate would earn per sale at typical rates. Needs no LinkJolt account. Use it when someone asks what commission to offer or how to structure a program.

billing.description: How the price is billed (default monthly)

commissionPercent.description: A commission rate the person is considering, e.g. 25

currency.description: Three-letter currency code of the price (default USD)

price.description: What a customer pays per billing period, e.g. 49

name: plan_affiliate_program
title: Plan an affiliate program
